nodes.label: Design Tokens (Modern Drafting Bench)
nodes.rationale: The single :root source of truth for every colour, space, radius, and motion value. Neutrals authored in OKLCH and stored as resolved sRGB hex (THREE.Color can't parse oklch); no #000/#fff. JS reads them via getComputedStyle and never hard-codes hex.

nodes.label: Three.js CDN Import Map (pinned 0.160.0)
nodes.rationale: Three.js is loaded as CDN ES modules only, pinned to 0.160.0 from jsDelivr for both 'three' and 'three/addons/'. No build step, no bundler, no npm, no @latest, no UMD global (ADR-001); it is the exact contract required by the platform and the sim's only runtime network dependency.

nodes.label: Boot Watchdog + WebGL Fallback
nodes.rationale: A classic script arms a self-healing fallback: if the pinned CDN module is blocked (campus firewall), the connection drops, or WebGL is unavailable, init() never runs and the iframe would sit blank. The learner reads a calm on-brand explanation instead of a void; main.js clears it on a successful boot and a merely-slow load self-heals.

nodes.label: Guided Stepper (step rail + step card)
nodes.rationale: The tutor panel: a vertical numbered step rail (a map you can only walk back along, never skip ahead) beside a step card of progressively disclosed controls. Ships with three placeholder steps to be wired in stepper.js / uiManager.js.

nodes.label: Compare View Scaffolding (card + 50/50 workbench)
nodes.rationale: DOM + CSS scaffolding ported from the Points topic (ADR-012 / ADR-037) making the template natively dual-mode: a floating compact 2D 'drawing sheet' card that expands into a true 50/50 workbench split (body.compare-split grid + #workbench-rail). The enter/exit logic and drawCompare() renderer are NOT ported since this template's main.js is a stub.

nodes.label: Quick-View Camera Buttons (dormant)
nodes.rationale: A segmented pill group (Top/Front/Side) that snaps the ortho camera square to each reference plane; clicking the latched view returns to perspective orbit. Ships HIDDEN in the starter because its projection/fold features were stripped.

nodes.label: Connector-Line Toggle (dormant)
nodes.rationale: A pill toggle that hides the dashed 3D->2D connectors and flattened projectors. Ships HIDDEN alongside the quick-views because the projection feature was stripped from the template.

nodes.label: Textbook Problem Library
nodes.rationale: A full-viewport, focus-trapped dialog whose cards are built by problemLibrary.js from src/problems.js, grouped by tier and filtered to the build's ENABLED_TIERS so a clone only shows solvable problems. The rAF loop pauses while it is open.

nodes.label: Active-Problem Header & Self-Check
nodes.rationale: A quiet paper card (not an accent wash) shown while a textbook problem is loaded: the statement, scaffolded hints revealed one at a time, and a neutral self-check that pops success-green with a check glyph only on a full match. 'Exit problem' clears the framing but never wipes the drawing.

nodes.label: Inline Term Definitions (glossary popover)
nodes.rationale: A dotted-underline word that reveals a plain-language popover on hover/focus/tap so the struggling first-year gets vocabulary defined in place without losing the real term; positioned by terms.js and exposed to screen readers via aria-describedby.

nodes.label: Domain Viewport Colors (HP teal / VP amber / PP violet)
nodes.rationale: Inside-viewport-only projection hues (HP teal solid, VP amber dashed, PP violet) held off the chrome blue, each carrying a non-colour cue (Two-Cue Rule). Consumed by the projection layer; teal<->amber is the CVD-safe pair.
